## Summary

I added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**: Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC of the given day. It constructs a timezone-aware UTC datetime at the end of the day and delegates to the existing `post` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**: Returns all entries posted at or after a given datetime, in order (oldest first). Filters the entries list based on the `posted_at` timestamp.

Both methods follow the project's design decision that all `posted_at` timestamps are timezone-aware UTC datetimes (per `docs/DECISIONS.md`). The implementation is minimal and leverages existing methods where appropriate. All existing tests continue to pass.
